subject.title: BL-buying-cart-04: la fecha de recogida solo bloquea domingos, no festivos

question: Should the fix accept the open PR's calculated national-holiday model for ES/PT/IT/FR, or require a different holiday source before landing?
rationale: The issue body explicitly lists multiple acceptable holiday-source directions, and the open PR picks one product/operations policy for a revenue checkout path.

options.title: Accept computed national holidays
options.body: Review and land the open PR after resolving conflicts if national holidays without an external dependency are sufficient for the first backend fix.

options.title: Require richer holiday source
options.body: Hold the fix until it covers the agreed carrier/local-holiday source, such as an API or maintained calendar beyond national dates.

options.title: Ship Spain-only first step
options.body: Narrow the backend fix to the already-versioned Spain list and track international holiday coverage separately.

recommendation.title: Accept computed national holidays
recommendation.body: Review and land the open PR after resolving conflicts if national holidays without an external dependency are sufficient for the first backend fix.

likelyOwner.reason: alexcanHamelyn is the requested reviewer for the open fix PR and has recent checkout-path history.
